headline: The 5 best Frame.io alternatives for agencies (2026)
standfirst: Frame.io is a strong video and creative review tool, and some agencies searching here also need QA for the live site they ship. Five options. One is ours. One is staying put.

superflowHeadline: Frame.io is a video review tool. Superflow is a QA tool + a team.
superflowBody: The team is AI agents, built from your QA checklist. They check every site change and pin what they find. Your team decides. Your client approves from a link.
superflowBestFor: agencies where a senior person still checks every live site by hand.

superflowScorecard.label: Who checks the site

entries.name: Filestage
entries.bestFor: creative teams that also want live-website review in the same place.
entries.standout: reviews video, images, designs, PDFs, documents, audio, and live websites in one workflow.
entries.limits: AI Review Agents pre-scan files, Business plan and up, capped at 50 agent credits a month. A person reviews what loads at a live URL. Pricing from EUR 199 per month (July 2026).
entries.vsAnchor: reviews live websites by URL, which Frame.io does not. Video comments are timestamped; frame-accurate review and Camera to Cloud: not yet verified.

entries.name: Marker.io
entries.bestFor: dev teams that want live-site reports filed straight into a tracker.
entries.standout: console logs, network requests, and session replay attached to every report, Team plan and up.
entries.limits: A person finds every issue on the live page. Video and creative-asset review: not yet verified. No Agency plan on its pricing page. Starter from $39 per month annual (July 2026).
entries.vsAnchor: built for live-site reports into a tracker, not creative-asset review. Frame-accurate annotation and Camera to Cloud: not yet verified.

entries.name: BugHerd
entries.bestFor: agencies pinning feedback straight on the live page.
entries.standout: element pins with browser, OS, and screen size attached; built-in kanban.
entries.limits: A person finds every issue. Video and creative-asset review: not yet verified. No memory concept. Pricing from $50 per month (July 2026).
entries.vsAnchor: built for live-site QA, not creative-asset review. Frame-accurate video tools and Camera to Cloud: not yet verified.

entries.name: Usersnap
entries.bestFor: product teams collecting end-user feedback through a widget.
entries.standout: annotated screenshots, screen recordings with voice, surveys, and a feature-request portal.
entries.limits: A person, usually the end user, reports every issue. Video and creative-asset review: not yet verified. Pricing from $49 per month billed yearly (July 2026).
entries.vsAnchor: a feedback widget for products, not creative-asset review. Frame-accurate video tools and Camera to Cloud: not yet verified.

stayHeading: The sixth option: stay on Frame.io
stayBody: Camera to Cloud gets footage from the set to the team before anyone leaves the shoot. Frame-accurate comments, version stacks, and a comparison viewer ship on every plan. Reviewers watch and comment free, no account needed (verified July 2026).
stayLine: If your work is video and creative assets, and you want frame-accurate review, approvals, and footage straight from the camera, stay.

faq.question: Which is the best Frame.io alternative?
faq.answer: Depends which criterion fails you. If it's checking the live site, not just footage, Superflow, the only one where the answer is a team, not a tool.

faq.question: Is Superflow just Frame.io with AI?
faq.answer: No. Frame.io's AI organizes and summarizes footage already uploaded. Superflow's agents check the live site itself, and a person makes every call.

faq.question: Can clients comment without an account?
faq.answer: On several, Frame.io included. In Superflow the client's yes is a recorded approval across the whole site, not a per-clip status.

faq.question: What does switching cost?
faq.answer: An afternoon. One snippet, or one click on Webflow, WordPress, GTM. Open projects finish where they are.
